label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to response.sendRedirect() URL path without sanitization. While 'host' is validated via regex, the path segment '/seg' accepts raw user input (request.getParameter('seg') defaulting to 'home'), enabling open redirect and path injection attacks. Resolved sink value at L24: https://{validated_host}/{user_seg}

evidence.note: User-controlled seg parameter flows to sendRedirect URL path without sanitization
